source_commit_role: Base commit. This benchmark uses the working-tree snapshot identified by source_sha256, including the decoded-length Go harness correction and the current Go prefix-selection consumer sources. Consumer Build/prefix selection is outside the timed work.

environment.observation_scope: Point-in-time preparation observation; not continuously monitored or enforced during timing
environment.background_workload: Benchmark jobs serial; agents coordinated to avoid builds/tests during timing. Other desktop/OS activity uncontrolled.
environment.runtime_policy: Default runtime/GC settings; no CPU pinning, forced GC, priority adjustment or power-plan change.

tool_versions.java:
openjdk version "17.0.17" 2025-10-21 LTS
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Microsoft-12574423 (build 17.0.17+10-LTS)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Microsoft-12574423 (build 17.0.17+10-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)

previous_attempt: An earlier campaign was aborted after a Windows Errno22 report-write failure in the synchronised checkout. All accepted samples below belong to a fresh complete run using temporary local report storage. No samples were selected or removed on timing grounds.
method: All engines receive identical UTF-8/LF fixture bytes. Fixed iterations per fixture across engines and modes. Serial fresh processes, balanced sample rounds with seeded shuffled condition order; syntax plus common string decoding and buffered file reads; entry JSON excluded. Two untimed warm-ups per process. Runtime default GC; finite-pass JIT behaviour, not guaranteed steady state. Process RSS includes startup, warm-up, buffers and runtime; Windows high-water sampled every 5ms, may miss final growth.

engines.runtime: Node.js v24.19.0; TypeScript shares this engine

openjdk version "17.0.17" 2025-10-21 LTS / OpenJDK Runtime Environment Microsoft-12574423 (build 17.0.17+10-LTS) / OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Microsoft-12574423 (build 17.0.17+10-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)

engines.build: rustc --edition=2021 -C opt-level=3 -C link-self-contained=yes; GNU target linked with Rust toolchain's bundled MinGW GCC

fixtures.name: mixed-32
fixtures.description: 32 occurrences, repeated keys, opaque annotations, Unicode, unset, pipe/triple blocks

fixtures.name: mixed-512
fixtures.description: 512 occurrences, repeated keys, opaque annotations, Unicode, unset, pipe/triple blocks

fixtures.name: mixed-20000
fixtures.description: 20000 occurrences, repeated keys, opaque annotations, Unicode, unset, pipe/triple blocks

fixtures.name: line-1mib
fixtures.description: One literal value with a 1,048,576-byte payload on one physical line

fixtures.name: blocks-32kib
fixtures.description: One pipe and one triple-quoted block, each with 32,768 ASCII x bytes plus 31 LF separators (32,799 decoded bytes)

fixtures.name: depth-256
fixtures.description: 256 written heading levels and one value per level; two-space structural indentation
